extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and stores

extDescription.message: Boost any tab's volume up to 600%, with bass and voice boost. Open source, no tracking, no data collection.

bassTitle.message: Bass boost: more low end for music

voiceTitle.message: Voice boost: clearer dialogue and podcasts

limiterTitle.message: Limiter: prevents distortion at high volume

resetTitle.message: Back to 100% and turn effects off

restoreTitle.message: Restore the volume you last used on this site

noPlaying.message: No other tab is playing audio.

engineAutoHint.message: Uses the page's own players first so fullscreen keeps working, and falls back to tab capture when needed.

engineCaptureHint.message: Works on every site, but Chrome limits fullscreen while a tab is captured.

rememberSites.message: Remember the volume I use on each site

autoRestore.message: Restore it automatically when I open the popup

allSites.message: Keep working after page reloads and in embedded players

allSitesHint.message: Optional. Grants access to all sites so the boost can be re-applied automatically. Nothing is read or collected.

shortcutsHint.message: Alt+Shift+↑ / ↓ change the volume, Alt+Shift+0 resets it. In the popup use the arrow keys.

shortcutsFirefox.message: Open about:addons → gear menu → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

privacyLong.message: OpenVolume works entirely inside your browser. It has no servers, no analytics and makes no network requests.

statusRestricted.message: The browser doesn't allow extensions on this page.

statusNoAccess.message: Open this popup on the tab you want to control and try again.

statusBusy.message: This tab is already being captured by another extension.

statusError.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

statusNoMedia.message: No audio or video found yet. It will be boosted as soon as playback starts.

statusUnsupported.message: This player can't be boosted (protected or cross-origin media).

statusBlocked.message: Click anywhere on the page once so the browser allows audio processing.

statusFullscreen.message: While a tab is captured Chrome keeps fullscreen videos inside the window. Tip: go fullscreen first, then use the keyboard shortcut.
